strongest_angle: Newly unsealed court documents and investigative reports from October 2026 reveal that a convicted drug smuggler and mob informant who died in 2006 may have assisted O.J. Simpson in covering up the 1994 murders of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ron Goldman.

key_facts.fact: Newly unsealed records and a report detailed in October 2026 suggest O.J. Simpson may have received help from a mob informant and drug smuggler who died in 2006 regarding the 1994 murders.

The New York Times investigation published in October 2026 revealed that a deceased drug smuggler with mob ties gave federal authorities information about the 1994 killings of Nicole Brown Simpson and Ronald Goldman.
In O.J. Simpson's book 'If I Did It', he described a version of the 1994 murders where he had help from a friend who disposed of the murder weapon and his bloody clothes.
Fox News reported in October 2026 on sealed records alleging that O.J. Simpson received assistance in covering up the double murder.
